summary: The shared fixture door correctly sanitizes Git subprocesses and its focused adversarial tests pass, but the commit does not route all ordinary tooling-owned temporary repository initializers through it. Thirteen test files still initialize temporary repositories through raw or local Git wrappers; the claimed single raw initializer is therefore not single.

tooling/src/_shared/git-fixture.ts:18-20 applies that filter to the supplied or inherited environment, then adds only controlled GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM values

all_ordinary_temp_repo_initializers_use_.failure_scenario: Run a tooling test under a Git hook environment carrying an additional local redirect such as GIT_COMMON_DIR. A raw initializer or a local wrapper that removes only GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE inherits that redirect. In an isolated reproduction, `env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_COMMON_DIR=<sentinel>/.git git -C <fixture> init -q` exited 1 and left a partial fixture .git instead of creating the fixture repository. The issue records the stronger observed failure where inherited hook redirects rewrote the shared repository's core.bare setting.

all_ordinary_temp_repo_initializers_use_.minimal_fix: Route the ordinary initializers and their subsequent fixture Git writes through execFixtureGit/runFixtureGit. Preserve purpose-specific candidate-index commands by starting from fixtureGitEnvironment and then adding only the controlled GIT_INDEX_FILE. Keep the payload-control raw call as the sole documented exception.

evidence: tests/tooling/verify/lib/repo-paths.test.ts:30-55 intentionally invokes raw Git so the negative controls can demonstrate fsmonitor/filter payload execution

the function starts from repoGitEnvironment or fixtureGitEnvironment, replaces HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME with scratch-owned paths, and uses a scratch-owned repository and scripts; inherited repository redirects and operator config cannot select the live repository
